name: typed-analytics-reference
description: Float, NULL and mixed-metric analytics verified using SQLite typed rows

queries.name: per-region-average
queries.sql: SELECT region, AVG(amount) FROM events GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

queries.name: empty-aggregate-null
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(amount), MAX(amount), AVG(amount) FROM events WHERE status = 'missing'

queries.name: conditional-regional-average
queries.sql: SELECT region, AVG(amount) FROM events WHERE coupon IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
